description: Read the Grants.gov record for up to 5 opportunities, given numeric opportunity ids or opportunity numbers: deadline, funding, eligibility, description, assistance listings, contact, attachments, packages, and latest revision metadata. Lists and narratives are bounded independent pages; follow each record pages continuation to retrieve the remaining section. An opportunity number is resolved across all statuses. A miss or an ambiguous number comes back as an unresolved entry with guidance, not an error.

application_package_offset.description: Zero-based open package offset; defaults to 0. Page size 10.

attachment_offset.description: Zero-based attachment offset; defaults to 0. Page size 30.

description_offset.description: Zero-based normalized description character offset; defaults to 0. Page size 12,000.

eligibility_offset.description: Zero-based normalized eligibility character offset; defaults to 0. Page size 6,000.

funding_category_explanation_offset.description: Zero-based normalized category explanation character offset; defaults to 0. Page size 2,000.

opportunity_ids.description: Numeric Grants.gov ids (e.g. 363423, or "363423" as search rows emit them), from grantsgov_search_opportunities opportunity_id. Accepts one whole string or an array, with at most 50 nonblank entries per list and 50 unique ids and numbers combined. Reads the first 5 identifiers, ids before numbers; remaining inputs have an executable continuation.

opportunity_numbers.description: Agency-assigned opportunity numbers (e.g. HRSA-27-005), matched exactly and case-insensitively across all statuses; one pair of surrounding double quotes is removed. Accepts one whole string or an array, with at most 50 nonblank entries per list and 50 unique ids and numbers combined. Reads the first 5 identifiers, ids before numbers; remaining inputs have an executable continuation. A number shared by several opportunities comes back as ambiguous with candidates.

related_opportunity_offset.description: Zero-based related opportunity offset; defaults to 0. Page size 10.

name: grantsgov_get_opportunity

continuation.description: Next identifier batch, omitted when the queue is exhausted.

deferred_ids.description: Unprocessed ids, omitted when none remain.

deferred_numbers.description: Unprocessed numbers, omitted when none remain.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_identifiers`: Both opportunity_ids and opportunity_numbers are empty or unset. `too_many_identifiers`: More than 50 ids and numbers combined after de-duplication. `upstream_unavailable`: Grants.gov did not respond, or returned a 5xx, a non-JSON body, a non-zero errorcode, or a backend-unavailable message, after retries. `rate_limited`: Grants.gov answered HTTP 429 (rate limited) through every retry, or asked for a wait longer than the retry budget. `upstream_route_unavailable`: Grants.gov answered HTTP 403 Missing Authentication Token on the detail route, or on the search route used to resolve opportunity numbers: the route no longer exists at the gateway. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Summary of unresolved inputs and what to call next.

additional_info_url.description: Agency link for more information (not fetched by this server).

agency_code.description: Owning agency code, e.g. HHS-HRSA. Omitted when the record lists none.

agency_contact.description: Applicant-facing agency contact as published. Omitted when none is listed.

details.description: Further contact text published by the agency.

agency_name.description: Owning agency name. Omitted when the record lists none.

applicant_types.description: Eligible applicant types; read with eligibility_narrative, which often narrows them.

code.description: The code, as grantsgov_search_opportunities filters take it.

label.description: Human-readable name. Omitted when not listed.

archive_date.description: Archive date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omitted when not listed (common on rolling and open-ended records).

created_date.description: Upstream attachment timestamp unchanged, including its stated timezone.

award_ceiling_usd.description: Largest single award, in US dollars. Omitted when not listed; 0 means listed as 0.

award_floor_usd.description: Smallest single award, in US dollars. Omitted when not listed; 0 means listed as 0.

category_code.description: Opportunity category: D discretionary, M mandatory, C continuation, E earmark, O other. Omitted when not listed.

category_label.description: Opportunity category name. Omitted when not listed.

close_date.description: Close date, YYYY-MM-DD: the application due date, or the estimated one on a forecast. Omitted when none is listed.

close_date_explanation.description: Agency text about the deadline, often the submission time rule. Omitted when not listed.

close_date_is_estimate.description: True on forecasts, whose close date is an estimate.

close_date_kind.description: fixed = a real (or, on a forecast, estimated) deadline; none_listed = no close date; placeholder = a far-future stand-in date the agency uses for "accepted anytime".

closed_package_count.description: Closed application packages on the record.

cost_sharing_required.description: Whether cost sharing or matching is required. Omitted when not listed.

days_until_close.description: Days from today (US Eastern) to close_date. Present only when close_date_kind is fixed; negative once the date has passed.

description.description: Opportunity description as plain text (up to 12,000 characters). Omitted when not listed.

description_truncated.description: True when the description page omits a prefix or suffix of the full description.

doc_type.description: Whether the record is a posted synopsis or a forecast.

eligibility_narrative.description: Agency text on eligibility (up to 6,000 characters). Omitted when not listed.

eligibility_narrative_truncated.description: True when the eligibility page omits a prefix or suffix of the full narrative.

estimated_total_funding_usd.description: Estimated total program funding, in US dollars. Omitted when not listed; 0 means listed as 0.

expected_awards.description: Expected number of awards. Omitted when not listed.

forecast_estimates.description: Forecasts only: the agency estimates of the synopsis timeline.

code.description: The code, as grantsgov_search_opportunities filters take it.

label.description: Human-readable name. Omitted when not listed.

funding_category_explanation.description: Agency text explaining the Other category (up to 2,000 characters). Omitted when not listed.

funding_category_explanation_truncated.description: True when the category explanation page omits a prefix or suffix.

code.description: The code, as grantsgov_search_opportunities filters take it.

label.description: Human-readable name. Omitted when not listed.

grants_gov_url.description: Public Grants.gov page for the opportunity.

last_revision_changed.description: Changed public field names; unknown names retain the upstream: prefix. Not a computed historical diff.

last_revision_note.description: Agency note on the latest active synopsis or forecast revision; omitted when unavailable.

last_updated.description: Date the record was last updated, YYYY-MM-DD. Omitted when not listed.

money_source.description: Which block the funding, eligibility, and contact fields come from: the synopsis on a posted record, the forecast on a forecast.

original_close_date.description: The original due date, YYYY-MM-DD. Present only when listed and different from close_date.
